question: What did Stellar Protocol 19 add, and how do generalized transaction preconditions / timebounds work?

golden.answer: Protocol 19 (June 2022) added generalized transaction preconditions via CAP-0021: time bounds, ledger bounds, minimum sequence number, minimum sequence age and ledger gap, and extra signers. They enable time-locked and sequence-conditioned transactions such as payment channels. CAP-0040 signed-payload signers shipped alongside. Soroban arrived in Protocol 20.
keyFacts: Protocol 19 introduced generalized preconditions through CAP-0021.
CAP-0021 adds time/ledger bounds, minimum sequence number/age/gap and extra signers.
avoid: Do NOT attribute preconditions to another protocol or CAP, or claim Protocol 19 introduced Soroban.

evidence: Live D 2026-11-14: https://stellar.org/blog (parallel-cli search, Protocol 19 announcement) -- 'Today, June 8, 2022 at 15:00 UTC, the Stellar public network [upgraded to Protocol 19]'
